title: Small Actions, Big Shifts: Reimagining Science & Math Classrooms
teaser: Roundtable on the future of science and math classrooms, jointly hosted by Seed2Sapling Education and tAcT at IASc Bengaluru.
homepageMatter: tAcT and Seed2Sapling Education jointly hosted an invite-only roundtable on 29 May 2025 at IASc, Bengaluru. Educators and school leaders from across India shared practices for nurturing scientific thinking in classrooms.
